findings.reason: the plan should name tests/test_declared_dependencies.py as the owner and direct §4 to import `OPTIONAL_SUBSYSTEM_ROOTS`/`build_census()` so the fresh-environment proof and the census share one definition of "optional".
findings.text: §4 requires the worker to classify each `imas_ambix/` module as inside or outside an optional subsystem so an unimportable module can be judged expected or a failure, but that boundary is already declared as `OPTIONAL_SUBSYSTEM_ROOTS` (and, per distribution, by `build_census()`) in the census module; re-encoding the three subsystem roots in the §4 proof creates a second owner of the same boundary that will drift the moment a subsystem root moves, and the two surfaces are exactly the pair the plan elsewhere insists "cannot disagree".

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the census hides the AST walk, the module-to-distribution mapping and the classification behind one `build_census()`, read by both the guard test and the fragment renderer, so the two cannot disagree.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4's fresh-environment import walk must decide per module whether it lies inside an optional subsystem, a boundary already owned by `OPTIONAL_SUBSYSTEM_ROOTS` in the census, and the plan does not name that owner.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; no section adds a CLI option, MCP view, refusal family or public product definition, so there is no added surface to retire or merge (the census symbols live in `tests/`, and §5's change is a pytest mark on existing tests).
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §2's census reuses `editable_checkout` from `tests/distribution_sources.py`, the shared helper extracted for `tests/physics/test_dependency_contract.py`, and §4 consumes the census's optional-distribution classification rather than inventing one.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §5 extends pytest-timeout's existing per-test mark (the repo's default is the ini `timeout = 300`) and §4 is an end-to-end fresh-environment proof, not a parallel layer over an existing reader.
